name: Yizhi Liu
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong CS-to-physical-robot fit in vision-based human motion retargeting, teacher-student reinforcement learning and safe worker-robot collaboration. A current Syracuse-directed humanoid study provides a concrete project basis, but no external summer position is established.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full 2026 Perception-and-action system paper, authored by Liu and his Syracuse PhD student Yanxi Liu, trains a vision-to-humanoid retargeting network plus teacher-student PPO controller in IsaacGym, tests transfer in MuJoCo, and deploys the distilled policy on an actual Unitree G1. Section 5.2 reports reproduction of eight tested actions, with representative physical flagger-signaling, pipe-carrying and concrete-block-posture examples in Figure 12. The block example is explicitly posture only because the three-finger hand cannot securely grasp a block. Thirty motions belong to human demonstration collection, not thirty verified physical robot tasks. The 82.45 mm tracking metric is reported in the simulation evaluation, and a quantified real-world trial count or success rate was not established. This is supervised short-horizon whole-body action execution, not demonstrated autonomous wall construction, dexterous manipulation or open-site deployment.

shortVisit.summary: Current university sources verify an active Syracuse research group and PhD supervision. No primary source checked explicitly offers an external-master eight-week summer visit or remote internship. The general university Student Intern mechanism is conditional administrative feasibility and is not a lab invitation; opportunity points remain zero.

Current Syracuse guidance permits a J-1 Student Intern route for a student pursuing a degree at a postsecondary institution outside the United States, with a degree-related training plan, at least 32 hours per week, English evidence, insurance, a department invitation and DS-7002. Individual eligibility still needs university approval.

The current policy allows paid or unpaid internships and independent financial support documented by bank statement or sponsor letter. It lists $1,200 per month plus $500 per accompanying dependent as a minimum, not a complete 2027 living-cost quote or a stipend.

University guidance says to plan at least eight weeks for visa-and-arrival processing; this is a lead time, not evidence of an eight-week minimum visit. Minimum appointment duration and current internal fees remain unverified.

Physical evaluation is limited to short motions. The press story’s thirty-task language is broader than the full paper and is not adopted. Quantitative simulation accuracy is not relabeled as hardware accuracy.
This Syracuse civil-engineering faculty member is distinct from same-name information-systems researchers. The public email is corroborated by author affiliations in primary publications.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
